Initial release of the Bug Bash Facilitator skill.

- Plan, run, and debrief structured pre-release bug bash sessions.
- Defines scope, recommends participant mix, and creates exploratory test charters.
- Provides tested templates: scope doc, charter board, intake form, triage rubric, prioritized fix list, and retrospective notes.
- Guides severity triage, post-session de-duplication, and bug fix prioritization.
- Optimized for SaaS release readiness; triggers on keywords like "bug bash", "test sprint", and "pre-release QA".
